name: Global activity (PMI)
summary: J.P.Morgan Global Composite PMI eased to 53.2 in October from 54.3 but stays well above the 51 Watch line
state: The J.P.Morgan Global Composite PMI fell to 53.2 in October from 54.3 in September, a level S&P Global says is consistent with global growth of about 2.9% amid heightened uncertainty (S&P Global, 5 Nov). That is above the 51 Watch line, so the signal stays Normal. No newer global figure was out as of 26 Nov; the November reading is due in early December.
for_you: Global business activity is still growing, which supports trade and jobs, though firms report more uncertainty.

sources.title: S&P Global — Global PMI remains elevated in October but dips on heightened economic uncertainty

why: Purchasing-manager surveys are the fastest read on whether the world economy is expanding or contracting.
drivers: Orders, inventories, trade policy, energy costs, credit conditions.
